description:
[BUG] A value-template (type-variable-bearing) activation reaches the backend as a lowered executable and panics: native lowering invariant failed ... value-template (a0) ... cannot be materialized. Repro: fn main do dbg(Enum.with_index(["a","b"], fn (x,_index) -> x <> "!" end)) end.

GOAL
No backend executable may have a value-template activation input. Drop the phantom mapper activation 164[a,a] at the executable-admission seam, using the invariant the compiler already enforces in two other places.

ROOT CAUSE (corrected 2026-06-20 by instrumentation on the repro; SUPERSEDES the value_types/27.8 theory in the old comment)
The invariant "a value-template covered by a ground sibling is not a runtime fact" (key_is_value_template + key_list_subsumes) is enforced at TWO of the THREE places runtime facts are enumerated, and MISSING at the third:
  surfaces           -> ground_dispatch_surfaces   (ok)
  flow resolutions   -> phantom_resolution_keys     (ok)
  demanded executables (closure.executables)        -> NONE   <- the gap
seal_semantic_closure (root.rs) admits every callsite-summary target and latent executable unconditionally; materialize_root lowers each. The mapper 164[a,a] is demanded via the reduce-closure 165[fun,a,a]; 165[fun,a,a] enters via the demand-frontier route. The flow-edge gate is FLOW-LOCAL -- it only sees ground siblings within one value's callable flow (ground count = 0 there) -- but 165's ground siblings (165[fun,binary,[]]) were discovered on a different path, so it structurally cannot see them. The phantom reaches closure.executables, which has no guard.

DISPROOF OF THE PRIOR (27.8 value_types) THEORY
The gate reads ActivationKey.inputs (addressed), never value_types. Removing the world.rs alpha_normalize_vars on value_types changed nothing. phantom_resolution_keys returns pruned=true for the flow edge, yet the executable still reaches the backend via the callsite route. The value_types frame divergence is real debt but is NOT this bug; 23 no longer blocks on 27.8.

NOT A TYPING-PRECISION BUG
Probe of every var-bearing activation: NO aggregate is ever collapsed to a bare var -- every list stays list(t), every tuple keeps its fields. The only bare variables are scalar leaves (element / index / acc) produced by analyzing polymorphic surfaces (reduce / Enumerable.reduce) generically, before the element is pinned to binary. The phantom is genuine redundant polymorphism (generic element covered by a ground binary sibling), not lost structure. So the fix is the prune, not value_types addressing.

FIX (path B -- minimal, fact-local, survives the seal's strangling per ../semantic-closed-proposal.html)
One per-executable admission guard at the single insertion point (root.rs, executables.insert): skip an executable whose activation inputs are key_is_value_template AND for which a ground sibling activation fact exists (same root+function, key_list_subsumes(ground, inputs)). Share one predicate core with phantom_resolution_keys (refactor in runtime_demand.rs). Pruning 165[fun,a,a] cascades: its callsite summary is never walked, so 164[a,a] is never demanded. A genuine polymorphic escape (no ground sibling) is kept and boxed, matching the existing gate. NOT a whole-closure post-pass -- that would entrench SemanticClosure, which is slated for deletion.

ORDERING CAVEAT
The guard's order-independence rests on the ground-sibling activation fact existing when the seal fires. Validate empirically that no intermediate seal firing materializes the phantom before its ground sibling appears; the corpus run is the oracle. The order-independent, fact-incremental realization (GroundSiblings fact + monotone-with-retraction) is fz-hwn.28, which path B seeds.

CHECKS
- fz2 interp on the repro prints ["a!","b!"].
- No backend executable has a value-template activation input.
- Re-enable compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts; flip/remove the tombstone compiler2_value_template_phantom_panics_at_lowering_until_fz_hwn_23.
- Full lib + fixture matrix green, zero warnings.

comments.text: Root cause refined (fz-hwn.27.5 probe): the key IS addressed; the phantom survives because value_types use the OLD alpha_normalize_vars frame (α0) while the key uses addressing (a0), so phantom_resolution_keys can't match it to a ground sibling to prune. Cure = value_types addressed in activation scope (retargeted onto fz-hwn.27.8). Predicate to flag it = fz-hwn.27.5.

title: Phantom polymorphic activation reaches the backend (FunctionId[a0,a0] not runtime-materializable)
